S. I. D.
F. O. REG
408
26/6/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

June 24th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that several members of the
monarchical party have arrived in Shanghai. They
are on very friendly terms with the new militaryparty
called Doong Ts Wei 同志會 .
The dismissal of the Military detectives
employed by the Arsenal will take effect from
1st proximo.
Five hundred soldiers left the Arsenal by
transport for Anwhui yesterday.
Twenty four members of the Kuomingtang party
have left for Kompo in order to organise a branch there.
Deputy Military Governor Lu Yoong Ziang 盧永祥
of Woosung has been unwell for the past few days.
Four men and two women who are wanted in connection
with a robbery in Ningpo were arrested in Chapei
last night. They were in possession of two revolvers.

Your Obedient Servant,

[签名]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

[手写批注]

pages.zh:
S. I. D.
F. O. REG
408
16年6月26日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916年6月24日。

先生：

据报，君主派数名成员已抵达上海。他们与新成立的军事团体“同志會”关系甚为友好。

兵工厂雇用的军事侦探的解职将于下月1日生效。

昨日，五百名士兵乘运输工具离开兵工厂前往安徽。

国民党二十四名成员已前往甘博（Kompo）(音译)，以便在当地组织分部。

吴淞副督军卢永祥过去数日身体不适。

昨晚在闸北逮捕了四名男子和两名女子，他们涉及宁波的一起抢劫案并被通缉。被捕时，他们持有两把左轮手枪。

您顺从的仆人，

[签名]

首席侦探督察长。

警务处总监。

[手写批注]

[手写缩写]
